# Unbundle

![Unbundle function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/cluster/02-cluster-properties.svg)

[Cluster functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Extracts the ordered fields of a Cluster with their complete types. A reference remains a reference; use Property Value explicitly to read the referenced control.

## Product execution profiles

The shared index declares native examples for this object; see [the examples below](unbundle.md#examples) and [document profiles and evidence boundaries](../../reference/studio-draft-examples.md). Older binding/help statements retained below can lag those product profiles. They do not establish or deny the separately measured native profiles. An example declaration alone is not an execution result or admission of every overload.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

<details>
<summary>Retained binding and help description</summary>

This is the source declaration, not the current measured product-execution assessment.

Positional Unbundle with 1..32 configured elementN rows. The required Cluster schema determines each output by its current authored fieldIds order. Each output retains the complete field type, nested schema and exact reference object; no Value property is implicitly read. Rows beyond the actual schema remain invalid and are never filled with a synthetic default.

</details>

## Examples

These are real `.frog` documents from the same index used by Studio. Backend names and expected results describe the examples; they are not execution certificates.

- [Construct a heterogeneous Cluster](../../examples/cluster.bundle.construct.md) — Without an incoming Cluster, Bundle constructs its ordered heterogeneous schema. The Cluster keeps individual exact field values. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Replace one ordered Cluster field](../../examples/cluster.bundle.replace-one.md) — The incoming Cluster fixes its field order and types. Only the wired first field is replaced; the String and Boolean values remain unchanged. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Bundle — preserve-all](../../examples/cluster.bundle.preserve-all.md) — An incoming Cluster retains every unwired field. Replacement rows keep their semantic positions even when preceding or intervening rows are unwired. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
